profile.description: Future-event prospect discovered while researching the leg manager's post-Labor-Day route. Adventure Zone emailed the Meeker Classic/Jammin' Lamb event in 2023, so outreach should acknowledge the prior connection and use a low-pressure future-event angle rather than force a last-minute 2026 booking. The leg manager's traveling setup is 2 Pirate's Rebellion units plus 1 Adventure Zone; Adventure Zone is the more natural fit here than a water-heavy Pirate setup.

notes.subject: Future opportunity - Meeker Classic
notes.body: 2026 Meeker Classic Sheepdog Championship Trials is Sept. 9-13 and includes food/artisan vending and family-oriented educational attractions. Adventure Zone Gmail history shows Amy emailed trials@meekersheepdog.com in May 2023 about Jammin' Lamb Festival & Meeker Classic. The event is a reasonable family audience but not an ideal full-package match for the leg manager's current traveling equipment of 2 Pirate's Rebellion units plus 1 Adventure Zone, especially because the Pirate package is water-heavy for September in Meeker. Reframe outreach as a natural check-back and future-event introduction: we noticed the event again while researching the route and would love to be considered for a future year/event if a larger Adventure Zone family-entertainment area would fit. Current official contact lists Executive Director Mary 'Maym' Cunningham at trials@meekersheepdog.com / 970-878-0111.

followUps.label: Future Meeker opportunity
followUps.reason: Use a low-pressure future-event follow-up rather than a hard last-minute 2026 pitch. Acknowledge the 2023 outreach and ask to stay on their radar for a future year/event where a larger Adventure Zone setup would fit.
